title: G1a fix round 1: log_run's goal lookup fails open, and the spawn/executor run rows are proven by subprocess-mocked tests (review T-0278)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 4945f86 "Normalize provider token usage logs" (T-0264) in git log; never drop it.
Review T-0278 on T-0264: (high) bus.log_run now calls bus.get(task_id) unguarded to derive goal_id; log_run used to be a best-effort append that could never raise, and spawn.py calls it inside an except block as a fallback logger, so a missing or corrupt task file now raises inside the logger and the following bus.update(status='failed') never runs. (med) acceptance 3 was not proven: tests/test_executor.py and tests/test_spawn.py already monkeypatch subprocess and assert fields on the runs/*.jsonl line but were not extended to assert goal_id, provider and the six normalised keys on rows produced through run_claude and executor._run.
Change:
1. bus.log_run: wrap the goal_id lookup in try/except Exception -> goal_id None (and provider still set); never raise from log_run for any reason the append itself does not raise; add tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_missing_task_still_appends and ::test_log_run_corrupt_task_still_appends.
2. tests/test_executor.py: extend the existing subprocess-mocked _run test (or add test_run_row_has_normalised_tokens) to assert the Codex row carries goal_id, provider 'codex' and input_uncached_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens with the values implied by the mocked usage (cached subtracted from input). tests/test_spawn.py: same for a Claude row through run_claude (provider 'claude', cache buckets from cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens).
3. No behaviour change beyond the guard.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 4945f86 below your commit
tests/test_executor.py and tests/test_spawn.py assert goal_id, provider and the six normalised keys on a row produced through the real _run and run_claude code paths with subprocess monkeypatched
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

Addresses review T-0278 (high and medium). Carries G1a. Posted by hand.
